mapper.insert: INSERT INTO anniversary_reminder (group_id, anniversary_id, remind_days, remind_date, is_sent, created_at) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{anniversaryId}, #{remindDays}, #{remindDate}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE remind_date = VALUES(remind_date), is_sent = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, group_id, anniversary_id, remind_days, remind_date, is_sent, sent_at, created_at FROM anniversary_reminder WHERE anniversary_id = #{anniversaryId} ORDER BY remind_days DESC
